title: Relative clauses 5: extra information clauses (2)
subtitle: to whom, most of which, …, which surprised everyone

theory.text: В придаточных с запятыми предлог может стоять перед whom (люди) и which (вещи): to whom, with whom, without which, of which. Это книжный стиль: David, to whom I spoke, wants to help., I had my phone, without which I would have got lost.
В разговоре предлог обычно ставят в конец, и тогда вместо whom говорят who: David, who I spoke to, wants to help. (не whom I spoke to), a small company, which I'd never heard of.
all of whom, most of which…

head: Люди
Вещи
rows: all of whom, most of whom, some of whom
all of which, most of which, none of which
neither of whom, both of whom, many of whom
two of which, half of which, the name of which

theory.text: Пример: Mike has four sisters, all of whom are teachers., I bought ten apples, half of which were bad. Похоже: the author of which, the cause of which.
which может относиться ко всему предыдущему предложению — «что, и это…»: Alex passed the exam, which surprised everybody. Здесь which = тот факт, что Алекс сдал экзамен.
Русское «…, что всех удивило» тянет сказать what. Но what здесь неверно — нужно which: Kate couldn't come, which was a pity (не what was a pity).

items.ru: (официально) Дэвид, с которым я говорил на встрече, хочет нам помочь.
en: David, to whom I spoke at the meeting, wants to help us.
David, with whom I spoke at the meeting, wants to help us.
David, who I spoke to at the meeting, wants to help us.

items.ru: (разговорно) Хелен, с которой я работаю, переезжает в Рим.
en: Helen, who I work with, is moving to Rome.
Helen, with whom I work, is moving to Rome.

items.ru: К счастью, у меня был телефон, без которого я бы заблудился.
en: Luckily I had my phone, without which I would have got lost.
Fortunately I had my phone, without which I would have got lost.
Luckily I had my phone, without which I would have gotten lost.
Luckily I had a phone, without which I would have got lost.

items.ru: Кевин показал мне свой новый дом, которым он очень гордится.
en: Kevin showed me his new house, which he's very proud of.
Kevin showed me his new house, of which he's very proud.
Kevin showed me his new house, which he's really proud of.

items.ru: Лиза работает в небольшой фирме, о которой я раньше не слышал.
en: Lisa works for a small company, which I'd never heard of.
Lisa works for a small company, which I had never heard of before.
Lisa works for a small company, of which I'd never heard.
Lisa works for a small firm, which I'd never heard of.

items.ru: У Майка четыре сестры, и все они учителя.
en: Mike has four sisters, all of whom are teachers.
Mike has four sisters, and they are all teachers.
Mike has four sisters, and all of them are teachers.

items.ru: Нам задали много вопросов, на большинство из которых мы не смогли ответить.
en: They asked us many questions, most of which we couldn't answer.
They asked us a lot of questions, most of which we couldn't answer.
We were asked a lot of questions, most of which we couldn't answer.
We were asked many questions, most of which we couldn't answer.

items.ru: Я примерил три пары обуви, ни одна из которых мне не подошла.
en: I tried on three pairs of shoes, none of which fitted me.
I tried on three pairs of shoes, none of which fit me.

items.ru: У меня два брата, ни один из которых не умеет водить.
en: I have two brothers, neither of whom can drive.
I've got two brothers, neither of whom can drive.

items.ru: У Ника пять велосипедов, на трёх из которых он никогда не ездит.
en: Nick has five bikes, three of which he never rides.
Nick has five bicycles, three of which he never rides.

items.ru: На вечеринку пришло много людей, некоторых из которых я знал.
en: Many people came to the party, some of whom I knew.
A lot of people came to the party, some of whom I knew.

items.ru: Я отправил ей два письма, ни на одно из которых она не ответила.
en: I sent her two letters, neither of which she answered.
I sent her two letters, neither of which she replied to.

items.ru: Я купил десять яблок, половина из которых оказалась гнилой.
en: I bought ten apples, half of which were bad.
I bought ten apples, half of which were rotten.

items.ru: Он выиграл деньги, половину которых отдал маме.
en: He won some money, half of which he gave to his mother.
He won some money, half of which he gave to his mum.
He won some money, half of which he gave his mother.

items.ru: Мы жили в милом отеле, название которого я забыл.
en: We stayed at a nice hotel, the name of which I've forgotten.
We stayed in a nice hotel, the name of which I've forgotten.
We stayed at a nice hotel, the name of which I forget.
We stayed at a nice hotel, whose name I've forgotten.

items.ru: Я прочитал книгу, автора которой не помню.
en: I read a book, the author of which I can't remember.
I read a book, the author of which I don't remember.
I read a book whose author I can't remember.
I read a book whose author I don't remember.

items.ru: Алекс сдал экзамен, что всех удивило.
en: Alex passed the exam, which surprised everybody.
Alex passed the exam, which surprised everyone.

items.ru: Кейт не смогла прийти, что было очень жаль.
en: Kate couldn't come, which was a pity.
Kate couldn't come, which was a shame.
Kate couldn't come, which was a great pity.
Kate couldn't come, which was a real shame.

items.ru: Поезд пришёл вовремя, чего никто не ожидал.
en: The train arrived on time, which nobody expected.
The train arrived on time, which no one expected.
The train arrived on time, which nobody had expected.
The train came on time, which nobody expected.

items.ru: Наш сосед всю ночь слушает музыку, из-за чего трудно спать.
en: Our neighbour plays music all night, which makes it hard to sleep.
Our neighbour plays music all night, which makes it difficult to sleep.
Our neighbor plays music all night, which makes it hard to sleep.
Our neighbour listens to music all night, which makes it hard to sleep.
Our neighbour listens to music all night, which makes it difficult to sleep.

items.ru: Автобус опоздал, из-за чего я опоздал на урок.
en: The bus was late, which meant I was late for class.
The bus was late, which made me late for class.
The bus was late, which meant I was late for my lesson.
The bus was late, which made me late for my lesson.

items.ru: Джек помог мне с переездом, что было очень мило с его стороны.
en: Jack helped me move, which was very kind of him.
Jack helped me to move, which was very kind of him.
Jack helped me move, which was very nice of him.
Jack helped me with the move, which was very kind of him.

items.ru: Дэн не отвечает на звонки, что меня беспокоит.
en: Dan isn't answering his phone, which worries me.
Dan doesn't answer his phone, which worries me.
Dan isn't answering my calls, which worries me.

items.ru: Он сказал, что уходит, что меня очень расстроило.
en: He said he was leaving, which upset me a lot.
He said he was leaving, which upset me very much.
He said that he was leaving, which upset me a lot.
He said he was leaving, which made me very upset.
